tokens.name: void
tokens.usage: Page ground: the night sky behind the whole site and around the hero frame. Text on it is bone or bone-muted.

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Second ground for alternating sections (shop, footer) and the base of the hero frame.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Anything that floats: product cards, tooltips, the rune menu panel, the bag drawer, the hotbar.

tokens.name: panel-raised
tokens.usage: Inputs, keycaps, hovered rows, the selected tab and the pedestal top of product cards.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Sticky header and hotbar once the page scrolls, always with a 14px backdrop blur.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind the rune menu, the mobile wheel and drawers.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: dividers between rows, card edges at rest, the coil rail. Never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Edges of inputs, secondary buttons, chips and the language switch (3.4:1 or more on every ground).

tokens.name: bone
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on void, night, panel and panel-raised (14:1 or more). Slip-cream, carried over from the social brand.

tokens.name: bone-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on every ground: type lines, captions, meta, footer links (6.8:1 or more).

tokens.name: bone-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders, disabled labels and the scroll badge ring (4.8:1 or more on every ground).

tokens.name: terra
tokens.usage: The brand terracotta on dark: the & of the logo, clay itself, prices on the product page, the 'last few' cue. As text on every ground (5.5:1 or more).

tokens.name: terra-deep
tokens.usage: Terracotta fills: the seal, clay glaze swatches, the edition bar when fewer than 5 are left. Text on it is bone at 24px or larger (3.7:1).

tokens.name: jade
tokens.usage: Spirit light and the one action per view: the primary button, 'added' states, the orb. As text on every ground (9.7:1 or more).

tokens.name: jade-hi
tokens.usage: Top of the primary button's gradient and the hot centre of jade glows. Never text.

tokens.name: on-jade
tokens.usage: Text and icons on jade and jade-hi fills (11:1).

tokens.name: ember
tokens.usage: Kiln fire: runes, sparks, lit keycaps, the active nav socket and the focus ring. As text on every ground (9.4:1 or more).

tokens.name: on-ember
tokens.usage: Text on ember fills, such as the 'Last 1' tag (10.8:1).

tokens.name: rarity-common
tokens.usage: Common, open edition, made to order. Bisque, the colour of unglazed clay. Item names, frames and tags only.

tokens.name: rarity-rare
tokens.usage: Rare, 30 made. Cobalt glaze. Item names, frames, tags and the edition bar of rare pieces.

tokens.name: rarity-epic
tokens.usage: Epic, 10 made. Plum glaze. Item names, frames, tags and the edition bar of epic pieces.

tokens.name: rarity-legendary
tokens.usage: Legendary, 5 made or fewer, and every 1 of 1 commission. Gold lustre. Item names, frames, tags, the hero's keeper.

tokens.name: on-rarity
tokens.usage: Text on any rarity fill, used by rarity tags (7.8:1 or more on all four).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Form errors and 'Sold out' text on every ground (6.5:1 or more). Pair it with a word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px solid ring at a 3px offset on every focusable element (9:1 or more on every ground).

families.display: "Archivo ExtraCondensed", "Noto Sans Georgian ExtraCondensed", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif
families.ui: "Archivo Expanded", "Noto Sans Georgian", Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: display-hero
styles.usage: The hero headline only, two lines. Scales down to 64px on phones.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Section titles: The shop, The forge, The guild. 56px on phones.

styles.name: display-m
styles.usage: The product name on its page and the destination title in the rune menu. 48px on phones.

styles.name: display-s
styles.usage: Footer callout, drawer and dialog titles, mobile section titles.

styles.name: display-xs
styles.usage: Product names on cards, tooltip titles, bag rows.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Prices, always number then GEL. 22px on cards, 44px on the product page.

styles.name: timer
styles.usage: The next-drop countdown and other big counters.

styles.name: label-l
styles.usage: Buttons and nav links, uppercase.

styles.name: label-m
styles.usage: Tabs, filter chips, eyebrows above titles, column heads. Uppercase.

styles.name: label-s
styles.usage: Rarity and status tags, micro captions under hotbar slots. Uppercase.

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: The hero description and section intros, at most three lines.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Every piece ships with its numbered lore card.
styles.usage: Paragraphs, product details, form copy. Keep lines under 68 characters.

styles.name: body-s
styles.sample: Ships in 2 to 4 days across Georgia.
styles.usage: Card type lines, help text, delivery rows, footer links.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Image captions, legal lines, inline hints.

styles.name: lore-l
styles.sample: Under Tbilisi the ground keeps every story ever told on it.
styles.usage: The keepers' dialogue in the hero, lore lines under section titles. Add SOFT 100 and WONK 1.

styles.name: lore
styles.sample: Lives in tote bags, eats crumbs, brings luck to anyone who forgets their keys.
styles.usage: Item flavour text: tooltips, cards on hover, the product page.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Stat rows in tooltips and the item sheet: label left, value right.

styles.name: edition
styles.usage: Edition numbers, drop numbers, countdown units. Always uppercase.

styles.name: keycap
styles.usage: Keyboard hints inside keycaps.

styles.name: ka-display
styles.usage: Georgian headlines. Never uppercase-transformed; 10% smaller than the Latin style it replaces.

styles.name: ka-body
styles.usage: Georgian paragraphs, labels and form copy.

styles.name: ka-lore
styles.usage: Georgian lore lines, in place of Fraunces Italic.

styles.name: rune
styles.usage: Asomtavruli, the oldest Georgian script, as runes. Decorative only: aria-hidden, never the only label.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside tags and keycaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a keycap and its label, between tags.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inner padding of chips and tags; gap between stat rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Minimum side gutter on phones; padding of tooltips and inputs.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding, grid gap of the shop, gap between buttons.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between an eyebrow block and the content under it.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Padding of large panels: the buy box, the rune menu panel, the footer band.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between a section title block and its grid.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of a section on desktop (64px on phones).

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Space above the footer callout and around the hero headline block.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Keycaps and rarity tags: cut stone, nearly square.

tokens.name: radius-s
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, the language switch, hotbar slots.

tokens.name: radius-m
tokens.usage: Product cards, tooltips, panels, the inspect stage.

tokens.name: radius-l
tokens.usage: The hero frame, drawers, bottom sheets and the rune menu panel.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Coils: the edition bar, the scroll rail, the orb and toggles. Never on rectangular buttons.

tokens.name: glow-jade
tokens.usage: The primary button and the orb. One per view.

tokens.name: glow-ember
tokens.usage: Lit keycaps, the active nav socket, rune nodes on hover.

tokens.name: glow-common
tokens.usage: Product card frame on hover, common pieces.

tokens.name: glow-rare
tokens.usage: Product card frame on hover, rare pieces.

tokens.name: glow-epic
tokens.usage: Product card frame on hover, epic pieces.

tokens.name: glow-legendary
tokens.usage: Product card frame on hover, legendary pieces and commissions.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Tooltips, menus, drawers, toasts: anything above the page.

tokens.name: shadow-carved
tokens.usage: Carved-stone bevel on keycaps, hotbar slots and inputs.

tokens.name: rim-light
tokens.usage: The lit top edge of the hero frame and the rune menu panel, as in the hero video.

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Max content width inside every section.

tokens.name: header-h
tokens.usage: Height of the desktop header; 60px on phones.

tokens.name: hotbar-h
tokens.usage: Height of the mobile hotbar, plus the bottom safe area.

tokens.name: touch
tokens.usage: Smallest tap target anywhere.

tokens.name: slot
tokens.usage: Hotbar slots, icon buttons and the language switch.

tokens.name: z-header
tokens.usage: Sticky header and the scroll rail.

tokens.name: z-hotbar
tokens.usage: Mobile hotbar.

tokens.name: z-drawer
tokens.usage: Bag drawer and filter sheet.

tokens.name: z-menu
tokens.usage: Rune menu and the mobile wheel.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Loot toasts, above everything.

tokens.name: dur-instant
tokens.usage: Press feedback, keycap lighting.

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Hover colour and glow changes.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Coil underlines, tooltips, tab changes.

tokens.name: dur-slow
tokens.usage: Drawers, the wheel fan-out, card reveals.

tokens.name: dur-epic
tokens.usage: The rune menu opening and the hero's first light. Once per visit.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Things arriving: panels, tooltips, coils drawing.

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: Things moving between two places: the ring turning, tabs.

tokens.name: ease-spring
tokens.usage: Clay: the wheel fan-out, hop and squash, the orb press.
